routes.notes:
Stops = the 22 Green Line BRT stations (copied with their OSM ids from data/systems/karachi-breeze.json GREEN). Abdullah Chowk - Numaish is exactly the Green Line corridor. PakWheels (20 Nov 2025) says the women-only Pink service was extended to the Green Line BRT corridor (it gives Numaish - Surjani Town, and Abdullah Chowk is the Surjani Town terminal). Express Urdu (8 Jul 2026) quotes Sharjeel Memon on the Pink bus service on the Green Line BRT. No source lists the Pink stops, so the assumption that Pink buses call at every Green Line station is an inference; hence stops_confidence medium and status still unverified. Windows 08-09, 13-14, 17-19 (Express Urdu 15 Nov 2025). Announced by the Sindh Information Dept to start 17 Nov 2025; runs only in three windows: 08:00-09:00, 13:00-14:00 and 17:00-19:00. Fare quoted as Rs 50 although the general PBS fare is Rs 80/120 since Feb 2025 (possibly a stale figure). No code, intermediate stops or length published, and not shown in the SMTA 2026 directory, hence status 'unverified'. 'Abdullah Chowk' is probably the Surjani Town junction at the Green Line northern terminus (unverified); coordinates left null.

Terminal positions set to the Green Line stations Abdullah Chowk and Numaish; intermediate stops unknown.

sources.title: سی ڈی اے کا اسلام آباد میں الیکٹرک ڈبل ڈیکر بسیں متعارف کرانے کا فیصلہ (Express Urdu)

routes.notes: Announced by CDA on 24 Sep 2026 (Express Urdu): 90-passenger electric double-deckers linking 15+ recreational, historic and tourist sites. The six sites are the ones the article names, in the article's order; this is NOT a confirmed stop order. No launch date, fare or operator given. Our id.

corroboration.note: Express Urdu (17 Mar 2026) on the Gulshan-e-Maymar - Tower EV launch: 12 buses via Sohrab Goth, Water Pump, Teen Hatti and M.A. Jinnah Road. Agrees with the existing R14; no change.

Express Urdu (14 Apr 2026): Sukkur-Shikarpur PBS to start the following week; Hyder Chowk-Kohsar and Hyderabad-Tando Allahyar 'soon'; Khairpur-Rohri and Khairpur-Ranipur next. All already represented in data/systems (SHIKARPUR, HYD-03 suspended, HYD-02, KHAIRPUR-01/02).

Express Urdu (19 Jan 2026): SHC hearing on the Chingchi ban. The Commissioner Karachi first banned Chingchis on 12 roads, then amended the notification to 30; about 60,000 Chingchis in the city. The notifications list banned roads, not Chingchi routes.

'Pink and Blue Suzuki service' (Hazara Express News, 1 Sep 2026): Traffic Police check vehicles for the prescribed colour and a pink or blue ribbon, with checkpoints on Mandian Road. Social posts describe pink as women/families and blue as men. This is separate from the July 2026 route-specific colour stickers (APP). No route list published.

Express Urdu (6 Jan 2026): BRT has 18 routes totalling 132 km; 52 hybrid and 50 electric buses to be added. Express Urdu (3 Mar 2025): 504 permit-holder buses/wagons on BRT routes were compensated; no list published.
DGPR Balochistan (YouTube, 23 Apr 2026): Green Bus service started from Quetta city to the NUST Balochistan campus after student demand; first 2 buses. No terminals or stops named, so not added.
DGPR Balochistan (YouTube, 8-9 Mar 2026): 4 buses, 19 km, 18 bus stations; no station names. TBT-1 stays stopless.

All 61 eTransit routes on the 23 Punjab district lines that punjab-round2 did not fetch (Attock ... Vehari, incl. Murree) match existing data/systems routes at 40-100% stop overlap (most 85-100%); no missing Punjab e-bus routes. Lowest overlaps, worth a re-check: muzaffargarh jhang-mor-to-turkey-hospital (0.40), railway-phattak loop (0.41), chakwal tehsil-chowk-to-balkasar (0.55), gbs-rajanpur-to-hajipur (0.62).
